description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule, which models an XHTML 1.1 module with information about elements, tags, and attributes, and provides methods for managing these definitions within the larger HTMLPurifier system.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule
classes.description: Represents an XHTML 1.1 module, encapsulating element, attribute, and content set information, along with methods to manage and extend module data.

methods.name: getChildDef
methods.description: Retrieves a proper HTMLPurifier_ChildDef subclass based on content_model and content_model_type of the element definition.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Sets up a new element in the module, including content model, attributes, and registration to content sets.

methods.name: addBlankElement
methods.description: Creates a non-standalone, placeholder element definition.

methods.name: addElementToContentSet
methods.description: Registers an element to a specified content set by name.

methods.name: parseContents
methods.description: Transforms a string description into a content model type and content model.

methods.name: mergeInAttrIncludes
methods.description: Merges attribute includes into an attribute array.

methods.name: makeLookup
methods.description: Creates a lookup table with boolean true for each list item.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Performs lazy loading and configuration setup for the module; intentionally left empty.
